tables.note: T2: framing similarity recomputed with wire-credited stories removed from both the outlet's and the core sample (bias-corrected as in Table T2, so 0 means indistinguishable from the core's non-wire frames); intercept-only mixed model over the 52 kept cells with random intercepts for outlet nested in country; the plan's decision rule reads a positive intercept as support. T3: for every GDELT event an outlet covered within one of the two wars (Gaza from October 7, 2023), the negative lag in days from the first core mention to the outlet's first mention (censored at 14 days) regressed on the number of core outlets that mentioned the event on its first core day, the available proxy for the number of core stories that day; random intercepts for outlet nested in country; the plan reads a negative coefficient (closer following for less-covered, more uncertain events) as support. Decisions by Holm-adjusted p < .05 across the pair, the T3 p being the larger of the two wars.
